premises.text: Rising deductibles and out-of-pocket costs force consumers to be proactive about health, yet direct-to-consumer health and wellness lab testing has remained largely unavailable
premises.evidence_span: direct-to-consumer testing for health and wellness labs has been virtually untouched in this revolution

premises.text: EverlyWell sells convenient at-home kits (blood, saliva, or urine) for key wellness markers with results in about five days via a secure, understandable dashboard
premises.evidence_span: EverlyWell provides convenient, at-home health tests with results you can actually understand

premises.text: Partner labs are CLIA-certified and the service is compliant for DTC testing in the states where it operates, with accuracy comparable to doctor-ordered tests
premises.evidence_span: all of our partner labs are fully CLIA-certified, proven reference laboratories

premises.text: A custom platform generates physician-authorized requisitions, fulfills kits across partner labs, and normalizes HL7 results into the consumer dashboard
premises.evidence_span: we have built a custom platform to make this happen

premises.text: Kits price from $79–$399 online, with planned insurance contracts, corporate wellness, and telemedicine partnerships
premises.evidence_span: We sell our kits online from $79 to $399

domains.name: at-home kits platform and lab compliance

value.text: Consumers get actionable, understandable health and wellness lab results on their own time and terms without opaque out-of-pocket clinic testing
value.evidence_span: Your test, your time, your terms

causal_links.evidence_span: forcing consumers to have to be more proactive with their health decisions
convenient, at-home health tests with results you can actually understand
These costs are actually lower by test than out-of-pocket or not-covered costs per test

notes: Eight test types and sample modalities folded into one at-home testing offering (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Beta traction metrics excluded. Vision of ubiquitous testing treated as value framing, not a premise. Singleton D1/D3 retained as separately revisable market gap and commercial module.
